Tentang pekerjaan ini

Frontend Engineer / Frontend Developer & UI Designer - Remote | Equity | Weekly Bonuses | AI Startup


Most frontend roles ask you to execute. This one asks you to lead.


We are an AI startup that is genuinely changing the world and we need a Frontend Engineer who has the combination of technical precision and genuine design taste to help us build products that people love from the first click. Whether you call yourself a Frontend Developer, UI Engineer, Web Developer or Product Designer who codes, if you build beautiful, fast user interfaces, we want to hear from you.


This is a role where you own the frontend, shape the user experience (UX), and ship work you are proud of.


What you will do:

  • Build and own the frontend of our AI-powered web applications, from first prototype to production
  • Turn ideas, wireframes and mockups into polished, responsive user interfaces
  • Design and develop UI/UX that is intuitive, accessible and pixel-perfect across desktop and mobile
  • Create and maintain a scalable design system and reusable UI components
  • Optimise web performance, page speed and cross-browser compatibility
  • Work closely with product, backend and AI engineers to integrate APIs and ship new features fast


What we offer:

  • Weekly bonus structure - your performance is rewarded every single week, not once a year
  • Equity - you are not just an employee, you are a builder with a stake in what we create
  • Best coding tools and AI plans provided - we invest in the people who invest in us
  • Fully remote - work from anywhere, on your terms
  • The team - you will work alongside some of the smartest, most driven people you have ever worked with. The bar here is genuinely high and it will make you better.


What we are looking for:

  • Proven experience as a Frontend Developer, Frontend Engineer, UI Developer or similar role building modern web applications
  • Strong UI/UX design skills and a portfolio that shows both your code and your design work
  • Someone who can full send. Someone who sees a design and immediately knows what's off and knows how to fix it.
  • Someone who doesn't need to be managed, they need to be unleashed.
  • Someone that has taste, with a sharp eye for visual design, typography and interaction design
  • Someone that is mission driven and excited about AI, startups and building products from 0 to 1
  • Someone with insane drive


Look forward to hearing from you

Hey Amara is a platform that helps people start and run their own remote recruitment agency in Australia and New Zealand, with no recruitment experience and without quitting their job.

Founded by recruitment mentor Harvey Jutton, who scaled his previous company to $500k a month in revenue, Hey Amara has launched 20+ recruitment agencies across Australia and NZ.

What does Hey Amara provide?
→ A step-by-step plan, from choosing a niche to winning clients and making placements
→ Recruitment training and mentorship for new agency owners
→ The tools, systems and automation needed to run a recruitment business
→ Full support at every stage

How do you start a recruitment agency with no experience?
Hey Amara takes new owners through each step: choosing a niche, setting up the agency, winning clients, sourcing candidates and making placements.

Can you start a recruitment agency part time?
Yes. Hey Amara is built for people who start a recruitment agency as a side business alongside a full-time job. Automation handles the repetitive work, so owners grow at their own pace.

How do recruitment agencies make money?
A recruitment agency is paid a fee by the employer when a candidate it introduces is hired, usually a percentage of the role's first-year salary.

Is recruitment a route into high-ticket remote sales?
Yes. Recruiters sell a high-value service to businesses by phone and video, and an agency can be run remotely from anywhere. Unlike a commission-only remote sales role, the owner keeps the clients and the business.

Who is Hey Amara for?
→ People looking to get into high-ticket remote sales
→ Sales professionals who want a remote business of their own
→ People who want to recruit in an industry they know
→ Career changers who want to become a recruitment agency owner

Hey Amara shares in the revenue each agency generates, so the team stays invested in every owner's results.

To find out if Hey Amara is a fit, message the team or visit the website.
